skills.name: Sora Passive
skills.description: Unique passive ability for Sora designed for competitive match viability.
skills.tips: Learn to manage passive triggers to dominate early game trades.

skills.name: Sora Skill 1
skills.description: Deals damage and applies control or mobility modifiers.
skills.tips: Spam this skill to farm quickly and harass enemy laners.

skills.name: Sora Skill 2
skills.description: Area control utility with slow/stun application.
skills.tips: Use this skill defensively or to setup ganks with allies.

skills.name: Sora Ultimate
skills.description: High impact Ultimate ability turning the tide of teamfights.
skills.tips: Coordinate Ultimate activation with teammate crowd control set pieces.

synergy.name: Miya
synergy.tips: Combines high utility, excellent lane pressure, and perfect teamfight synergy with Miya.

counters.name: Miya
counters.tips: Sora excels at diving in with explosive burst damage and AOE CC, so squishy heroes without escape abilities—like Layla, Miya, and Hanabi—will find themselves helpless against Sora's relentless assault.
